info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Events Ticket Status API provides real-time insights into the status of tickets for various events. By accessing this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information about ticket availability, including options for sold, pending, and available tickets. This API is essential for event organizers and ticketing platforms that need to monitor ticket sales and statuses effectively. Developers integrating this API can enhance user experiences by providing current ticketing information to consumers purchasing or exploring event attendance options.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of tickets in the system. You can use it to check whether tickets are open, closed, or in progress, providing essential insights into the ticket management process.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of tickets. This body should contain the necessary parameters to specify which tickets' statuses are being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current ticket status.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of tickets requested through the GET operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates if the ticket status inquiry was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the inquiry.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the ticket status.

audit.description: Auditing information related to the ticket status inquiry.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.description: Schema representing the response for a successful ticket status inquiry.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the ticket status inquiry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket status inquiry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket status inquiry was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing auditing information for ticket status inquiries.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
